acceptanceCriteria: behavior-adapter --check (or equivalent) validates the whole request and returns every refusal it can determine in one deterministic, ordered list without producing a result.
Refusals that depend on an earlier failed stage are reported as not-evaluated rather than silently omitted.
body: Each behavior-adapter refusal names one field, so callers learn the contract by trial and error (10 attempts observed: identity, revision set, input repository, duplicate paths, migration identity, discovery identity, variation shape, flow derivation). Source: beamfall/corvint#717.
title: docs corpus behavior-adapter: --check mode that reports every refusal in one run
